messages:
santiago (partnerships): Vendor just sent a revision: a container swap at origin due to manifest imbalance. This could shuffle which marketplace reservations get shipped first. Need a quick map.

maya (sales): Which reservations are at risk? We have two enterprise proofs next week that need guaranteed racks.

randy (logistics): Pulling manifest mapping now. One sec.

vendor-api-bot: Manifest update: swap performed. Container swap ID CSW-990 flagged. Items re-assigned; some marketplace allocations moved to later shipments.

santiago (partnerships): Affected resvs: MKP-8111, MKP-8112, DED-9044. DED-9044 is enterprise SLA.

zoe (customer-success): Notified enterprise customer representative. They want a confirmation window by EOD.

maya (sales): If DED-9044 is impacted we need to propose a temporary cross-stock from our EU spares. Can logistics confirm transit time?

randy (logistics): EU spare to EU customer is 48h ground. We'll need legal acceptance for a temporary serial swap and a ticket for inventory movement.

santiago (partnerships): Let's do it. Prioritize SLA. I'll draft the outbound note. Keep announcement to marketplace partners internal.

vendor-api-bot: Update: CSW-990 release expected +2 days pending carrier consolidation.

zoe (customer-success): Customer replied: "We need confirmation by 1700 CET or we'll consider pushing our pilot."

maya (sales): Ok we have to move fast. Randy please action EU spare allocation now and post tracking. I'll coordinate with CS for the message.

randy (logistics): EU-SPARE-07 allocated to DED-9044. Transit ETA 36h. Tracking: https://vendor.example.com/track/EUSP07

santiago (partnerships): Message to customer sent: "We're provisioning an equivalent rack from our EU spares immediately; ETA ~36h. We'll confirm serials and provide live tracking. No change to SLA."

zoe (customer-success): Customer acknowledged and thanked us.

vendor-api-bot: CSW-990 status: container consolidation complete. Next update in 24h.

santiago (partnerships): Closing thread; will link to ticket SUP-9004 for audit."
